responsibility: Implements the state-graph-specific extensions layered on top of diagnostics::digraphs for representing program memory state in diagnostics, especially analyzer-style reports. This file defines the stable string encodings for state_graphs::node_kind and node_dynalloc_state, plus the state_node_ref accessors that read and write those semantics through SARIF-roundtrippable property-bag keys on generic graph nodes, including attributes such as region kind, dynamic-allocation state, type, and dynamic extents. It is the executable bridge that maps generic diagnostic graph nodes to memory/state concepts consumed by state-graph visualizers and exporters.
same_name_distinction: Implements the state-graph-specific behavior declared in diagnostic-state-graphs.h, especially the string encodings and property-bag accessors that map generic diagnostic graph nodes to state_graphs concepts such as node_kind, dynamic-allocation state, and dynamic extents. Unlike the header, this file provides the executable translation layer on top of diagnostic-digraphs nodes.
